name: Advanced 403 Redirect
description: Redirects access-denied (403) responses whose path matches a stored rule to an admin-configured internal destination, optionally showing a message.
project_description: Advanced 403 Redirect lets site administrators define per-path rules that change what happens when a request returns a 403 (access denied). Each rule is stored as an 'access_denied_url' content entity holding a source URL, a destination URL and an optional message. When a non-administrator hits a path that matches a rule's source, an event subscriber replaces the default access-denied page with a redirect to the configured destination and can display the message. Source URLs are validated to resolve to an existing, unpublished entity; destination URLs are validated to begin with a slash and resolve to a valid local route.
